params.name: legacy
params.description: [beta] true: historical raw-model_id-keyed view (listing-only; an unregistered id it lists is still 404 on the inference path). Default false: canonical view (id = canonical_id).

params.name: pricing
params.description: [beta] 'usd': emit the OpenRouter-standard shape with per-token USD decimal strings under the top-level `pricing` field (for external pricing aggregators, e.g. TKX); models without a USD price are omitted. Default: native prices under `pricing`, USD under `pricing_usd`.

params.name: provider_address
params.description: Filter by provider address (OR: match any)

params.name: input_modality
params.description: Filter by input modality, e.g. text, image (AND: must support all)

params.name: supported_parameter
params.description: Filter by supported parameter, e.g. temperature (AND: must support all)

items.docs: Get all available AI models. By default the response is the **canonical view**: one row per `canonical_id`, with curated registry metadata and endpoints aggregated (max context, union of params/formats, cheapest pricing); `id` is the canonical model id. A model stays listed even when all its endpoints are temporarily unhealthy (health is not a visibility filter; routing falls back to unhealthy endpoints so a listed model is always routable).
